## Fit

No model_sum column is archived. The original 1/2/4/8-box rows, the per-box model sums and the --fit output from pr24-20261102 were not committed.
C = 1 is an assumption, not a reproduced fit. It is conservative only where the measured error is at or below the requested target; the 5 degree angular-spread case above is a documented unsupported regime.

To refit, rerun the campaign with picBunchVelocityBinsMeasure and compare_velocity_bins.py --fit, then add the model_sum values to the CSV and run this script again.
